mapper.select: select * from internship_stage_assignment where confirmation_record_id = #{confirmationRecordId} order by current_flag desc, id desc limit 1 for update
select * from internship_stage_assignment order by student_id asc, stage_no asc, sequence_no asc
select * from internship_stage_assignment where student_id = #{studentId} and current_flag = 1 order by id asc for update
select * from internship_stage_assignment where student_id = #{studentId} and stage_no = #{stageNo} and current_flag = 1 order by id desc limit 1
select * from internship_stage_assignment where student_id = #{studentId} and stage_no = #{stageNo} and current_flag = 1 order by id desc limit 1 for update

select distinct first_stage.student_id from internship_stage_assignment first_stage where first_stage.stage_no = 1 and first_stage.current_flag = 1 and first_stage.status not in ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'REPLACED', 'INTERRUPTED') and not exists ( select 1 from internship_stage_assignment second_stage where second_stage.student_id = first_stage.student_id and second_stage.stage_no = 2 and second_stage.current_flag = 1 ) order by first_stage.student_id
select count(*) from internship_stage_assignment where student_id = #{studentId} and stage_no = #{stageNo}
select count(*) from internship_stage_assignment where student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: insert into internship_stage_assignment ( student_id, stage_no, sequence_no, source_type, source_assignment_id, application_id, confirmation_record_id, company_id, company_name, position_id, position_name, internship_start_time, internship_end_time, status, current_flag, quota_released, quota_released_at, quota_release_reason, remark, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{studentId}, #{stageNo}, #{sequenceNo}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceAssignmentId}, #{applicationId}, #{confirmationRecordId}, #{companyId}, #{companyName}, #{positionId}, #{positionName}, #{internshipStartTime}, #{internshipEndTime}, #{status}, coalesce(#{currentFlag}, 1), coalesce(#{quotaReleased}, 0), #{quotaReleasedAt}, #{quotaReleaseReason}, #{remark}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update internship_stage_assignment set confirmation_record_id = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update internship_stage_assignment set quota_released = 1, quota_released_at = now(), quota_release_reason = #{reason}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and quota_released = 0
